instruction: There is a barcode scanner lying on the left side of the table, close to the robot, and a small teal box standing on the table to the right of the middle. Use the left arm to pick up the scanner and the right arm to pick up the box. Lift both above the table and point the head of the scanner at the box to scan it. Keep holding the scanner and the box at the end; do not release them.
